tasks.subject: Task 0: Per-pass signal config (schema-derived)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Derive per-pass {dimensions, categorical_fields, has_image_field} from the bundle schema (field suffixes + enum fields + _photo), no hardcoded literals.

**Files:** Create `app/services/extraction_pass_signal_config.py`; Test `tests/unit/test_extraction_pass_signal_config.py`; may add `iter_routable_pass_fields` helper in `app/services/ontology_bundles.py`.

**Acceptance Criteria:** derive_pass_signal_config(bundle_key)->dict[str,PassSignalConfig]; kinematics dims {length,angle}; guidance categorical {guidance_type,seeker_type}+has_image True; antenna has_image True+dims {length,angle,gain}; identity passes not consumed.

**Verify:** `pytest tests/unit/test_extraction_pass_signal_config.py -v`

tasks.subject: Task 1: Signal-detector primitives (measurement/categorical/image)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure per-chunk detectors: pass-specific measurement (bounded matcher + dimension vocab), categorical (enum phrases), image-presence (#/pictures/).

**Files:** Create `app/services/extraction_signal_detectors.py`; Test `tests/unit/test_extraction_signal_detectors.py`.

**Acceptance Criteria:** measurement pass-specific true/false; designators S-75M/V-88/5Ya23 => no measurement (reuse field_value_grounding.has_unit_token); spelled+imperial (feet, meters per second) match; categorical guidance phrase true, 200 kg false; image_present true only for #/pictures/.

**Verify:** `pytest tests/unit/test_extraction_signal_detectors.py -v`

tasks.subject: Task 2: absolute_union selection mode
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add absolute_union to select_candidates + cosine_tau/Literal to RetrievalProfile; keep candidate iff any signal fires; return subset (possibly empty, no k_min).

**Files:** Modify `app/services/ontology_bundles.py` (RetrievalProfile), `app/services/extraction_candidate_scoring.py` (select_candidates ~724); Test `tests/unit/test_absolute_union_selection.py`.

**Acceptance Criteria:** selection_mode accepts absolute_union + cosine_tau=0.55; measurement/cosine kept, no-signal dropped; [] when nothing fires; diag_out per-signal keep counts; topk/guarded unchanged.

**Verify:** `pytest tests/unit/test_absolute_union_selection.py tests/unit/test_dispatcher_vr_wiring.py -v`


tasks.subject: Task 7: Online validation (USER-ORDERED GATE)
tasks.description:

**Goal:** Prove end-to-end that absolute_union holds entity-recall vs full-doc baseline on NMUSAF, SA-2/SR-71 PDF, Engagement before any default flip or removal of narrow_min_doc_tokens.

**Files:** none (operational; harness in /home/josh/.guardrank_eval_state/).

**Acceptance Criteria:** deployed live (selection_mode=absolute_union verified in-container); full-doc baseline + absolute_union run per doc on idle pool; per doc absolute_union entities >= 0.9x full-doc AND status COMPLETE; per-doc entity table captured to verdict file.

**Verify:** `cat /home/josh/.guardrank_eval_state/absolute_union_validation_verdict.txt`

tasks.subject: Task 8: Recompute selection performance metrics (shipped code vs baseline)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Recompute the full selection performance-stats suite — recall, precision, fraction-selected, F1, per-signal keep contribution, per-pass breakdown — for the SHIPPED `absolute_union` selector vs the `guarded_quantile` baseline, against the bake-off ground-truth dataset. Confirm the shipped code reproduces the spec's offline-prototype figures (no implementation drift). Runs LAST (after Task 7); uses shipped detectors/selector, not prototype scripts; offline against existing ground truth (no new runs).

**Files:** Create `reports/absolute_union_metrics.py`; Output `reports/absolute_union_metrics_report.txt`. No production source changes.

**Acceptance Criteria:** loads `reports/*/bakeoff_dataset.parquet` (dedup on run_id,pass_name,chunk_index) + derives per-pass config via derive_pass_signal_config('air_defense_v3'); absolute_union recall/precision/frac-sel/F1 + per-signal keeps, per-pass + aggregate (shipped code; used==1 positive); guarded_quantile q=0.5 baseline same metrics; image signal joined from ArcadeDB ExtractionChunk for _photo passes OR reported via Task 7 (no silent omission); comparison table captured to report file; aggregate recall within tolerance of spec prototype (~89.6%@22%@7.7%), >3pt drop flagged.

**Verify:** `.venv/bin/python reports/absolute_union_metrics.py && cat reports/absolute_union_metrics_report.txt`

